text: The BEST customer service.  I’ve been coming here for years for my state inspection and they’re always fast and courteous.  The owner always greets me with the warmest and best smile!  He’s just genuinely in a good mood and thankful for your business.  Will continue coming back.  Check it out!

I rarely write reviews, but these guys are worth it! I went in for my first state inspection as part of my move to Texas, and I will be back every year! They are incredibly friendly, professional, and fast. There were two customers ahead of …
Awesome guys, super fast and helpful

I came to Quix a few years ago and I haven't looked back.  They are always super friendly and equally as fast.  Depending on how busy they are I can be in and out in under 15 minutes, and I've never been here longer than 30 minutes.  Highly recommended!

The absolute best! Easy, very very quick and they are the most friendly people. I was in and out in 10 minutes. Don’t waste your time anywhere else! You won’t regret supporting this sweet small business!
I use this location monthly for our company vehicles. Always friendly and quick! Bring your insurance card and you’ll be be in and out. Usually 10-15 minutes total time.

Quick and efficient. Nice guys.

Edit: been going here for years now. Super fast, staff are the same friendly …

This place is awesome. They are super friendly and not the super pushy sales people I get used to every time I take my car somewhere. Their prices for basic things like coolant and windshield wiper replacement are totally reasonable.  They are quick and very attentive to customers.
DON'T GET A STATE EMISSIONS TEST HERE! They charge $1 more than other places if you pay cash, and $2 more if you pay with credit card. Go one block down and get it at Take 5 Oil Change for $18.50.

I rarely write reviews but there is a reason for all the five star ratings. I went for my vehicle inspection on my lunch break and was in and out in 15 minutes, even during what I assumed was a busy time of day for them. Wish I found these guys sooner. So nice and so deserving of your business. I'll be back for sure!

EXTREMELY friendly staff, clean office with places to wait. Advised on low fluids that I already knew about but did not try to talk me into buying, because of that I did!!! Restroom is used by staff and customers and it was cleaner then …

The gentleman that took care of me was so kind.  He got me in ASAP, filled my coolant, and washer fluid and cleaned the marking on my windshield I’ve tried to take off forever lol! He gave me cleaning wipes.  Just made me feel very welcomed.  It was amazing service.  Especially during a time like this.

On point. Pulled up. They ran the inspection with no issues. They work smooth, and fluent. It is advised that you show up early because their work is so good the lines can be long. Otherwise schedule yourself for sure. …

Came here because of the reviews and was not disappointed. The customer service was excellent and the price was fair. I got my car inspection quickly and even got some coolant because they were kind enough to point out I needed some (when I …

I’m new to TX and was a little lost on the process. They were quick even with what looked like 10 customers ahead of me and gave me resources on what the steps were to get registered in the state. Very knowledgeable and customer focused. Will definitely use their services again!
Professional, fast, and friendly. I’m back for my third year and I can’t see myself going elsewhere for inspections. …
Very fast even told me what was wrong with my break light and fixed it fast and cheap great customer service!

After trying three garages in east Dallas and having them tell me they couldn’t do an inspection (1) because the inspector isn’t in, or (2) because they were too busy, I tried this place. Extremely courteous and very much lived up to their name. I was in and out in less than 15 minutes (probably less than 10).

Fast! Friendly and nice.  What more could you ask for? They even gave me a print out of where to get my car registered.  Considering my toddler was acting like well, a toddler,  I super appreciated their friendliness.
Very efficient guys working here. Got me in and out quickly. I just needed an inspection and the guy just asks for the keys and insurance. They check it and I pay them for the service. …

Knocking star after my most recent visit. I was very pleased with the service I received last week with taking in my Lexus. I returned today with my Tesla and it was a different story. The inspection was quick, but the employee was …

I’ve been here three times since moving to Dallas in 2016. I have consistently gotten an appointment easily and they are always exceptionally fast and friendly. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. The location is very easy to find, clean and with ample parking.
quick and efficient service. recommend paying with cash. would come back
I needed to get my state inspection, stopped here and the gentleman were both very professional and courteous. Very fast service!! I was in and out within 10 minutes. Definitely recommend!!
Best inspection place in town. The owners are very nice, quick to checkout the car, and offer repair services as well. Highly recommend if you’re by SMU or Greenville and want your car in good hands!

Can't express enough how awesome they were. Great price, and they pointed out a couple soon to be major issues and with my permission, fixed it before It became a major problem. Its hard to find mechanics who care about making sure your vehicle leaves better than it came in. Thanks guys, ill be back!

Motor City was absolutely amazing! My car broke down and they took care of everything quickly and professionally. The staff was incredibly kind, patient, and helpful the whole time. They explained what was going on, didn’t push anything …

I am so glad I came in here today! Seriously such nice staff & they did great work. I really appreciate their patience and willingness to explain things about my vehicle that I don’t understand. Will definitely be coming back for all my car repair needs! Such a good job.

There's are many reasons this shop is so highly rated. Customers service and customer interactions. No charge for a tire balance service, i did not expect it and willing to pay more that what they wanted to charge. I was out of there in …

They literally saved me from a bigger headache.

My valve was worn and leaking. They replaced it for 15 bucks. …
These guys are the best. Always instant service, willing to work with you on price to get it right. They know everything there is to know about tires. Go here with confidence.

This place is awesome!  Discount Tire told me I needed a new tire. I didn’t believe them and decided to try this place since I drive by them on my way to work. I literally pulled up to this place, they jacked my car up with me in it, pulled …
Good service , friendly and good price for used tires

They were fast for my tire patch and it was only $15 for each patch. Consistently they have done an honest job and I wanted to let others know. Also, considering the time I would have spent at other locations, this was perfect

I needed two tires today and stopped by during the day. I was in and out in about 30 minutes. The new (used) tires seem great and everyone was very helpful. The pricing was fair compared to some of the other tire shops in Dallas.
Good, quality, and honest work. This is the GO TO! Unlike every other major retail tire shop, you don’t feel like you’re being taken advantage of. I will be back.
Lots of bays for service.  Nice group of guys, fast, quick and reasonable prices.  I had a flat tire, that had a big nail. Very happy and I would definitely recommend. 🙌🏾 …

My boss recommended I get my alignment done here, I was surprised how well it turned out. Never did I imagine the old beater car would have a straight steering wheel. 10/10 will return for future tuning

Good prices on tires. Friendly service. But they severely over-torque lug nuts. It you have a flat and need to remove a wheel they installed, you may not be able to get the lug nuts off without breaking a lug bolt. This has happened to me twice.
My car would start shaking once I went over 50 mph. They told me I needed my front rim repaired, which only took a day, and one of my back tires balanced and now the problem is fixed! Thanks guys!
